shortDescription: Install and manage PowerShell scripts from a PSRepository

options.name: allow_prerelease
options.description: If C(yes) installs scripts flagged as prereleases.

options.name: maximum_version
options.description: The maximum version of the script to install. Cannot be used when I(state=latest).

options.name: minimum_version
options.description: The minimum version of the script to install. Cannot be used when I(state=latest).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the script you want to install or remove.

options.name: repository
options.description: The registered name of the repository you want to install from. Cannot be used when I(state=absent). If ommitted, all repositories will be searched. To register a repository, use M(community.windows.win_psrepository).

options.name: required_version
options.description: The exact version of the script to install. Cannot be used with I(minimum_version) or I(maximum_version). Cannot be used when I(state=latest).

options.name: scope
options.description: Determines whether the script is installed for only the C(current_user) or for C(all_users).

options.name: source_password
options.description: The password portion of the credential required to access the repository. Must be used together with I(source_username).

options.name: source_username
options.description: The username portion of the credential required to access the repository. Must be used together with I(source_password).

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the script. C(absent) removes the script. C(latest) will ensure the most recent version available is installed. C(present) only installs if the script is missing.
